page.PAGE_SHARE_YOUR_LINK_GUESTS_FILL_IN_THE_: Share your link. Guests fill in the form and choose their tickets.
page.PAGE_KEEP_TRACK_OF_ORDERS_CHECK_TICKETS_: Keep track of orders. Check tickets at the door using their admission QR code.
